ConnectionStrings.//: Non Windows developers: switch to the docker compose SQL Server from the repo root.

RateLimiting.//: Development only. Production keeps the default of 10 attempts per 5 minutes per IP; the end to end suite signs in from four parallel browsers and would otherwise lock itself out.

Jwt.//: Development only signing key. Real deployments read this from a secret store, never from a committed file. AuthenticationSetup refuses to start if this exact value appears outside Development.

Identity.//: Development only demo accounts, one per role, created on startup if absent. IdentitySeeder refuses to run outside Development because these credentials are public.
